QUOTE: Its `reason` string says that no `index_scope` was declared and names where it looked, and it adds advice to declare one in `.clew.yaml`. ... The point of that reason string is that a fallback scope says the boundary was not chosen.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the whole-repo fallback carries a reason string stating that no scope was declared, and that the string exists to show the boundary was not chosen, so the scope is not silently guessed.
